questionSnapshot.question: In what year did EPCOT open at Walt Disney World?

notes: q687 concerns the resort’s 1971 opening and q102 Animal Kingdom’s 1998 opening: different establishments and events. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.

verification.context: Walt Disney World, specified park/attraction; current naming/layout at review date.

premise.reason: EPCOT Center opened to guests on October 1, 1982.

sources.locator: Opening paragraph gives October 1, 1982 park opening; later original-layout paragraph identifies Future World and World Showcase as areas.
Walt Disney Archives account, opening paragraph dates public opening October 1, 1982; later paragraph calls Spaceship Earth a geodesic sphere.

challenge.notes: Distinguished public opening from later October dedication ceremonies and the 1966 EPCOT concept. Both official historical accounts agree on 1982; the other years cannot also identify that event.
